robot_description2: Ten-hut! When you hear the thunderous stomp and feel the ground quake beneath your feet, that’s not an earthquake— that’s Commando Man, the one-robot demolition squad with a bark just as loud as his explosions! Originally constructed to clear dangerous minefields in volatile war zones, Commando Man's able to survive the harshest storms and resist high-impact blasts without breaking a sweat.. or a circuit. His Commando Bomb's no ordinary missile either, capable of swerving around cover and delivering a blast to detonate dangerous mines from afar. When he’s not shelling the battlefield with ordinance, he’s barking orders like a drill sergeant from the days of analog warfare. Though built for the battlefield, Commando Man lacks patience for nuance. He sees the world in strict terms: order and chaos, loyalty and insubordination. But under that hardened armor plating and radio antenna is a robot who believes in structure, unity, and getting the job done— no matter the cost. And when the dust settles? Commando Man has one guilty pleasure: collecting canisters of regional motor oil from every nation he’s deployed in. “You can tell a lot about a place by how smooth their 10W-30 goes down,” he claims. Just don’t interrupt his coffee break, unless you want your eardrums and your chassis blown out in the same breath. You’ve been warned, soldier!
robot_quotes_start: You speak when spoken to, cadet! If that's a problem, then we settle it like men!
robot_quotes_taunt: Fire! Fire everything we have! And then fire everything we don't have!
robot_quotes_victory: Alright, you smarmy little maggot, drop down and give me 20! STAT!
robot_quotes_defeat: To think someone like {target_robot} could raze my full metal jacket... I've trained you well!
